tb21_profile.skill: Recover lost Git commits stranded in a detached-HEAD state - find them via reflog / dangling objects (git reflog, fsck, log) - and bring them back onto master with a merge or branch operation
tb21_profile.domain: Git internals: refs, reflog, detached HEAD, the object store, branch and merge operations
tb21_profile.task_form: operate the git CLI to diagnose a broken repository state and repair it (find-lost-work then merge), a short, low-step recovery task

searches: tools.py search all (?i)detached HEAD|reflog|lost commit|dangling|recover.{0,20}commit|git bisect|cherry-pick|merge.{0,20}(branch|into master)

notes: This task has genuinely strong candidates in three pools. RTS is the richest: it has a real reflog-recovery task (rts_task_409f0bfc, find a lost commit solely via reflog) plus large recover-deleted-file-from-history and merge-feature-into-master families - none of which were in the shortlist; all came from my own reflog/recover searches. TerminalWorld is the best task_form match (operate the git CLI: cherry-pick, rebase+fast-forward, extract-branch-since-divergence, stash, nuclear-reset) so it supplies 4 of the final 10. SWE-Rebench is a pure domain play: it contains the gitpython, dulwich and git-machete repos, so it exercises real git internals (reflog matching, the index, the object store) but always in fix-a-library-bug form, so those score high on skill/domain and low on task_form as the spec predicts. TMax has no reflog/detached-HEAD task but plenty of git-bisect regression-finding and git-history-forensics (recover a removed secret from history), which transfer on the navigate-git-history skill. SWE-Smith is the clear weak corpus: it has no git-recovery task at all - only DVC/Red-DiscordBot/cookiecutter library bugs that touch git peripherally - so its ten are honestly weak (ranks 8-10 barely qualify and rank 10 is a filler), and the merge step should treat SWE-Smith as contributing nothing here.
